summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 9,300,000 Class A ordinary shares plus pre-funded warrants for 40,700,000 shares at $0.20 per share/$0.0001 exercise price, for total gross proceeds of $10M. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acts as exclusive financial advisor receiving 7.0% fee. This is a routine capital-raising transaction via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
